_inter_block.schematic: the amp's output (MP4/MN3 drains) and the core mirror's gate drive -- one node in the schematic. PR #67 drew the two drain ends only, and named the gate end `GDRV_GATE` because a gate could not be contacted; both ends are one drawn conductor now (the `core_mirror` terminal is its gate lane), so the node needs no second name
MPAMP drain to the amp input pair's common source
MP1 drain to its NMOS diode load and on to MN3's gate
MP2 drain to its NMOS diode load and on to MN4's gate
MN4 drain to the diode-connected MP3 and MP4's gate
the R2A leg's low end (through its trim taps) to Q1's emitter bus and MP2's gate -- the amp's VINN node
R2A's low end into leg A of the downward-only trim ladder (DR-002)
MPOUT's drain and the high ends of both divider legs -- the reference output
R2B's low end into leg B of the trim ladder
the R2B leg's low end (through its trim taps) to R1's head and MP1's gate -- the amp's VINP node
R1's tail to Q2's emitter bus
VSS trunk: the amp's NMOS rails and guard rings plus both PNP base ties (the diode-connected PNPs' base and collector both sit on VSS)
VDD trunk across all three PMOS groups -- MPOUT/MPAMP and MP3/MP4 sources, and MP1/MP2's own n-well tie (the input pair's bulk terminal, which its sources do not carry)
